run_upload_gtest: run upload_gtest.py to upload a Google Test patch for review with automatic cc to the gtest discussion group
run_upload_gtest_with_cc: run upload_gtest.py with --cc flag to upload a Google Test patch and add custom recipients alongside the gtest group
run_upload_gtest_no_cc: run upload_gtest.py without --cc flag to upload a Google Test patch and automatically add googletestframework@googlegroups.com
run_upload_gtest_preserve_args: run upload_gtest.py passing all upload.py command line flags unchanged except adding the gtest cc group
run_upload_gtest_replace_cc: run upload_gtest.py with existing --cc flag to replace or merge recipients while ensuring the gtest group is included
